items.exampleEn: Grandpa narrated the story while we looked at the pictures.
items.exampleZh: 爺爺一邊講述故事，我們一邊看圖片。

items.exampleEn: The children said they saw a phantom in the old house.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們說他們在那棟老房子裡看到幽靈。

items.exampleEn: In stories, the phoenix rises again from fire.
items.exampleZh: 在故事裡，鳳凰會從火中重生。

items.exampleEn: It's too cold to sunbathe today.
items.exampleZh: 今天太冷了，不能做日光浴。

items.exampleEn: Chat shows are popular late at night.
items.exampleZh: 談話節目在深夜很受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: She dreams of becoming a film-maker.
items.exampleZh: 她夢想成為電影製作人。

items.exampleEn: Science fiction often shows life in the future.
items.exampleZh: 科幻作品常常描寫未來的生活。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother watches a soap opera every evening.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天晚上看一部肥皂劇。

items.sentenceEn: The chat show host asked funny questions.
items.sentenceZh: 談話節目主持人問了一些好笑的問題。

items.audioEn: The new science fiction series starts next Monday at nine p.m.
items.audioZh: 新的科幻影集下星期一晚上九點開播。

items.sentenceEn: Don't sunbathe for too long in the hot sun.
items.sentenceZh: 不要在大太陽下做日光浴太久。

items.sentenceEn: The phoenix is a symbol of hope in many stories.
items.sentenceZh: 在許多故事裡，鳳凰是希望的象徵。

items.stemEn: The ____ spent three years making this movie.
items.stemZh: 那位電影製作人花了三年拍這部電影。

items.stemEn: My uncle likes to ____ on the beach for hours in summer.
items.stemZh: 我叔叔夏天喜歡在海灘上做好幾個小時的日光浴。

items.passageEn: My aunt is a film-maker. Her new film is about an old theater with a phantom who appears at night. A famous actor narrates the film, and the music is beautiful. Last week, she was a guest on a chat show to talk about it. She told the host that she grew up watching soap operas and science fiction. Next year, she wants to make a film about a phoenix. To relax, she likes to sunbathe at a small resort by the sea.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是電影製作人。她的新電影講一座老劇院裡，有個夜裡才出現的幽靈。一位知名演員為電影配旁白，音樂也很美。上星期，她上了一個談話節目介紹這部電影。她告訴主持人，她是看肥皂劇和科幻作品長大的。明年，她想拍一部關於鳳凰的電影。為了放鬆，她喜歡到海邊一個小度假村做日光浴。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨的新電影在講什麼？
options: 一群年輕人的太空旅行

questions.questionZh: 阿姨在節目上告訴主持人什麼？
options: 她明年要搬到國外去住

items.promptZh: 我哥哥很愛看科幻電影。
referenceEn: My brother loves science fiction movies.
My older brother really likes science fiction films.
rubricZh: science fiction 表示「科幻」，例如 science fiction movies／films 等說法
主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 -s（例如 loves、likes）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 那位演員下週會上一個談話節目。
referenceEn: That actor will appear on a chat show next week.
That actor is going to be on a chat show next week.
rubricZh: 用 chat show 表示「談話節目」（寫 talk show 也正確）
表示未來的寫法都可以（例如 will appear、is going to be 等）
